dog.description_text:
Sake is a lovable boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for people! He’s always ready to say hi and is happy to make new friends wherever he goes.

This curious guy loves checking out the world around him and seeing what’s happening. He’s also a big fan of yummy food and absolutely loves getting pets, so there are plenty of ways to win him over!

With his friendly nature, curious spirit, and love of attention, Sake is ready to be someone’s new best friend. If you’re looking for a young pup who’s always excited to see you, Sake is ready to say hello!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
